title: Causative Constructions: Delegating & Orchestrating Actions (Have, Get, Make, Let)
subtitle: CEFR C1–C2 • Active Agent Causatives vs. Passive Service Causatives

topics.title: 1. Active Causatives (Have + Person + V1 vs. Get + Person + To V1)
topics.subtitle: Delegating Tasks vs. Persuading Someone to Act
topics.explanation: Digunakan ketika kamu tidak melakukan pekerjaan itu sendiri, melainkan meminta, menugaskan, atau meyakinkan orang lain untuk melakukannya. 'Have someone do X' berarti memberi tugas secara profesional; 'Get someone to do X' berarti membujuk atau meyakinkan; 'Make someone do X' berarti mewajibkan.
topics.rationale: Dalam manajemen proyek dan kepemimpinan tim, kita jarang mengerjakan semuanya sendiri—struktur causative mengomunikasikan pendelegasian secara akurat.

formulas.pattern: S + have / make + [Person] + V1  |  S + get + [Person] + to + V1
S + didn't have / make + [Person] + V1  |  didn't get + [Person] + to + V1
How did you get + [Person] + to + V1?  |  Did you have + [Person] + V1?

conditionalExamples.positive: I'll have our DevOps engineer configure the SSL certificate, and we got the client to approve the scope.
conditionalExamples.negative: We didn't make the junior developers work overtime during the release.
conditionalExamples.question: How did you get the legacy system to sync with the new webhook?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Perhatikan perbedaan struktur: 'have [person] configure' (tanpa to), tetapi 'get [person] to approve' (memakai to).

xrayTokens.nuance: 'Have + Agent + Bare V1' menandakan pendelegasian tugas

specialExceptions.title: Jangan Menyisipkan 'To' Setelah 'Make' atau 'Let' Aktif
specialExceptions.explanation: 'Make someone do' dan 'Let someone do' selalu memakai V1 murni tanpa 'to'.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: The new linter makes us to write cleaner code.
specialExceptions.correctExample: The new linter makes us write cleaner code.

tipsAndTricks: Ingat aturan 'TO': hanya 'GET + orang' yang memakai 'to + V1' (get him to sign). 'Have', 'Make', dan 'Let' semuanya tanpa 'to'.

topics.title: 2. Passive Causatives (Have / Get + Something + Verb-3)
topics.subtitle: Arranging Services & Outcomes Without Naming the Agent
topics.explanation: Digunakan ketika fokusnya adalah benda atau sistem yang diproses oleh pihak lain/profesional, tanpa perlu menyebut siapa yang mengerjakannya (have the contract reviewed, get the server upgraded).
topics.rationale: Jika kamu berkata 'I repaired my laptop', artinya kamu membongkarnya sendiri. Jika kamu berkata 'I had my laptop repaired', artinya kamu membawanya ke teknisi profesional.

formulas.pattern: Subject + have / get + [Object / Thing] + Verb-3 (Past Participle)
Subject + haven't had / didn't get + [Object / Thing] + Verb-3
Where did you get / have + [Object / Thing] + Verb-3?

conditionalExamples.positive: We had the smart contract audited by an external security firm.
conditionalExamples.negative: I haven't gotten my passport renewed yet.
conditionalExamples.question: Did you get the translation proofread by a native speaker?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: 'Get + Object + V3' sedikit lebih kasual dan dinamis dibandingkan 'Have + Object + V3' yang lebih formal.

xrayTokens.nuance: 'Have + Object + V3' menunjukkan pekerjaan dilakukan oleh pihak ahli

specialExceptions.title: Urutan Kata Menentukan Makna Total
specialExceptions.explanation: 'I had washed the car' (Past Perfect: aku sendiri yang mencuci mobil) vs. 'I had the car washed' (Passive Causative: aku menyuruh pencuci mobil mencucinya).
specialExceptions.wrongExample: I had repaired my phone at the service center.
specialExceptions.correctExample: I had my phone repaired at the service center.

tipsAndTricks: Gunakan pola 'Let's get this [deployed / reviewed / merged]' sebagai ekspresi sehari-hari yang sangat alami di tim engineering.

scenario.interlocutor: Investor menanyakan apakah dokumen kontrak sudah diperiksa oleh konsultan hukum
scenario.intent: Menyatakan bahwa dokumen tersebut telah diperiksakan ke tim legal eksternal.

practiceQuiz.question: Kalimat mana yang paling akurat menyampaikan bahwa pihak luar yang memeriksa kontrak tersebut?

options.text: We had reviewed the contract by a corporate lawyer.
We had the contract reviewed by a corporate lawyer.
We had the contract review by a corporate lawyer.

deepExplanation.whyCorrect: Pola Passive Causative meletakkan objek ('the contract') di antara 'had' dan Verb-3 ('reviewed').
deepExplanation.whyOthersFail: Opsi A berarti kami sendiri yang mereview, dan Opsi C memakai V1 alih-alih V3.
